evidence.text: An introductory course for students in Computing and Information Technology, covering fundamental knowledge related to the major and basic computer science. Furthermore, the course focuses on teaching soft skills such as: time management and planning skills; writing, presentation, and technical report delivery skills; teamwork skills, as well as the ability to determine professional responsibilities based on ethics and law. Upon completion of the course, students can explain issues related to the field of study, apply basic computer science knowledge in subsequent courses, and acquire the soft skills necessary for their studies.
Develop essential soft skills including time management, planning, effective study methods, documentation writing, presentation, and teamwork.
Clearly define professional responsibilities based on ethical and legal standards in the field of information technology.
Explain general issues regarding the field of study, hardware and software structure, information representation in computers, and basic programming foundations.
Proficiently apply soft skills in studying and teamwork, including time management, technical report writing, and public speaking.
Comply with ethical and legal rules when performing professional tasks and major course projects.
